candidates.name: TdhGetEventInformation
verified_facts: Retrieves TRACE_EVENT_INFO metadata used to decode an EVENT_RECORD.
semantic_limits: Metadata lookup can fail or differ by provider version and must match the event descriptor exactly.

candidates.name: TdhGetPropertySize
verified_facts: Calculates the required buffer size for a selected event property.
semantic_limits: A size result does not validate property type, count, bounds, or meaning.

candidates.name: TdhGetProperty
verified_facts: Retrieves a selected event property into a caller-provided buffer.
semantic_limits: Property reads require metadata, exact descriptor selection, bounds checks, and original record correlation.

candidates.name: TdhEnumerateProviders
verified_facts: Enumerates registered ETW providers and their names and GUIDs.
semantic_limits: Provider registration is not proof of provider activity or trusted executable identity.

candidates.name: TdhEnumerateManifestProviderEvents
verified_facts: Enumerates event descriptors defined by a manifest-based provider.
semantic_limits: Manifest definitions show possible events, not events actually emitted during recovery.

candidates.name: TdhGetManifestEventInformation
verified_facts: Retrieves metadata for a manifest provider event descriptor without requiring an event instance.
semantic_limits: Static event metadata cannot prove runtime emission, order, or payload validity.

candidates.name: Get-WinEvent
verified_facts: Reads Windows event logs and ETL files and supports provider, log, XPath, XML, and hashtable filtering.
semantic_limits: Permissions, ordering, circular retention, and filtering can affect results; cmdlet output must be joined to raw identifiers.

candidates.name: wevtutil
verified_facts: Enumerates logs and publishers and can query, export, archive, configure, or clear logs.
semantic_limits: Mutation subcommands are not used; read-only output still requires exact command, exit code, encoding, and timestamp capture.

candidates.name: Security event 4688
verified_facts: Records creation of a new process when Audit Process Creation is enabled and can include creator, subject, process and command-line fields.
semantic_limits: Event availability depends on audit policy and command-line policy; PID values require timestamp and process-start correlation.

candidates.name: Security event 4624
verified_facts: Records a successful account logon with subject, logon ID, logon type, account, process and network fields.
semantic_limits: A logon event does not prove the canonical runner executed and must be joined by logon ID, account, session and process evidence.

candidates.name: Security event 4698
verified_facts: Records creation of a scheduled task and includes subject, task name and task XML content.
semantic_limits: Task creation does not prove task execution or current ownership; task XML and runtime records must be compared.

candidates.name: Security event 4702
verified_facts: Records an update to a scheduled task and includes subject, task name and task content.
semantic_limits: An update event does not establish the final registered definition or that the intended task ran.

candidates.name: Security event 4697
verified_facts: Records installation of a service when the relevant audit subcategory is enabled and includes service and subject details.
semantic_limits: Service installation is not service execution proof and must be joined to current configuration, binary identity, PID and timestamps.
